insalivate.translation:
vt. 使混涎
[医] 混涎, 和涎

insalivation.definition:
n. The mixing of the food with the saliva and other
   secretions of the mouth in eating.
insalivation.translation:
n. 混涎作用
[医] 混涎作用

insalubrious.translation:
a. 对身体有害的, 不健康的, 不卫生的
[医] 有碍卫生的, 有碍健康的

insalubrity.definition: n. the quality of being insalubrious and debilitating
insalubrity.translation: n. 有碍健康, 不健康

insalutary.definition:
a. Not salutary or wholesome; unfavorable to health.
a. Not tending to safety; productive of evil.
insalutary.translation: a. 不卫生的, 不健全的

insane.definition: a. afflicted with or characteristic of mental derangement
insane.translation:
a. 患精神病的, 极愚蠢的
[医] 神经错乱的

insane at time of offence.translation: [法] 犯罪时患有精神病者

insanely.translation: adv. 精神错乱地, 疯狂地, 极其愚蠢地, 脱离实际地

insanitary.translation:
a. 不卫生的, 有碍健康的
[医] 不卫生的

insanitation.definition:
n. Lack of sanitation; careless or dangerous hygienic
   conditions.
insanitation.translation: n. (环境的)不卫生(状态),卫生设施的缺乏

insanities.definition:
plural of insanity
n. relatively permanent disorder of the mind
insanities.translation:
(insanity 的复数) n. 疯狂, 愚顽, 精神错乱
[医] 精神病

insanity.definition: n. relatively permanent disorder of the mind
insanity.translation:
n. 疯狂, 愚顽, 精神错乱
[医] 精神病

insatiability.definition:
n. The state or quality of being insatiable;
   insatiableness.
insatiability.translation:
n. 不知足, 贪求无厌
[医] 贪食不饱, 不饱症

insatiable.translation:
a. 不知足的, 贪求无厌的
[医] 不能满足的, 不饱的

insatiableness.definition:
n. Greediness of appetite that can not be satisfied or
   appeased; insatiability.

insatiably.definition:
r. to an insatiable degree
r. in an insatiable manner; with persistence but without satisfaction
insatiably.translation: adv. 贪得无厌地；无法满足地

insatiate.translation: a. 不知足的,欲壑难填的

insatiateness.definition: n. The state of being insatiate.
